basic_details.short_information: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) has officially announced the Project Technical Support I Recruitment 2026 with 01 opening. Candidates with a maximum age of 28 years and qualifications including 10th + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT/ ITI) with two years of relevant experience or a three-year Graduate degree in the relevant subject/field with one year of relevant experience are eligible to apply. Desirable qualification includes work experience in a molecular biology laboratory. Interested candidates can submit their applications via email on or before 02 August 2026. Direct

Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-1 position is 02-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-1 post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-1 post in the AIIMS Delhi recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have completed 10th with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI) and two years of relevant experience, or a three-year Graduate degree with one year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-1 position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 28 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-1 role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 18000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-1 post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page.
